title: Early LDL -cholesterol reduction in patients with acute coronary syndrome: a randomized clinical trial
official: Early LDL -cholesterol reduction in patients with acute coronary syndrome: a randomized clinical trial
summary: Main objective: The primary objective is to evaluate the early efficacy at 6-week of a lipid-lowering therapy in ACS patients using a treat-to-target strategy, which accounts for baseline LDL-C levels, in comparison to a default strategy, which is based on 2023 ESC guidelines recommendations on ACS as well as the 2025 Focused Update of the 2019 ESC/EAS Guidelines for the management of dyslipidemias.
